metadata.question: Does vegetation greenness (NDVI) in Toliara, Madagascar on average decrease during September 2021-2022 compared to the 2000-2015 average for the same period?

data.exec_msg:
Baseline period (2000-2015): Found 534 images.
Recent period (2021-2022): Found 127 images.
Avg. NDVI 2000-2015: 0.0785 (Pixels: 106)
Avg. NDVI 2021-2022: 0.0674 (Pixels: 106)
Conclusion: NDVI decreased in the recent period.
A
